Title: Maiev Hotfix Patch #1
Subtitle: Hotfix
CleanedNotes:
=== Heroes: Genji ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue preventing certain cleave attacks, such as Malthael's Basic Attacks and Xul's Cursed Strikes, from removing stacks of Genji's Dodge.

=== Heroes: Jaina ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • The Wintermute Talent now correctly causes Jaina's Water Elemental to mimic her Basic Abilities.

=== Heroes: Lunara ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • The Galloping Gait Talent no longer grants a permanent Movement Speed bonus.

=== Heroes: Maiev ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Casting Spirit of Vengeance just as a Core is destroyed will no longer cause the Spirit to cease animating.
  • Activating Naisha's Memento will now correctly display an icon indicating its duration in the buff bar.

=== Heroes: Nova ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue causing Holo Decoys to deal slightly more damage than intended after learning Lethal Decoy.

=== Heroes: Rehgar ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • The Rising Storm Talent will no longer increase Lightning Shield's damage versus non-Heroic enemies.

=== Heroes: Tyrael ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • The Stalwart Angel Talent's tooltip now displays the correct values for its duration and Armor bonus.
